reading.title: Fiscal Impact Statement for CR-118-2025: Payments in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) Agreement for the Fort Washington by Vintage Project

candidates.quote: Summary: The Resolution proposes to approve the terms and conditions of a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) agreement between Prince George’s County and Fort Washington by Vintage, L.P., Inc. for a 304-unit multi- family development available at 70% of Area Median Income.

Summary: The Resolution proposes to approve the terms and conditions of a Payment in Lieu of Taxes (PILOT) agreement between Prince George’s County and Fort Washington by Vintage, L.P., Inc. for a 304-unit multi- family development available at 70% of Area Median Income.
The PILOT would be in effect for 40 years.
Assuming a first-year payment of $117,648 in FY 2027 instead of a real property tax payment of $482,511, the County loses -$364,863 in general fund revenue, growing to a loss of -$402,404 by FY 2030.
Over the 40-year term of the PILOT the County is estimated to lose -$14.9 million on a net present value basis.
The first-year PILOT payment is specified at $ 117,648 growing by 2% annually over the 40-year term.
The revenue loss should be weighed against the benefit of adding 304 affordable housing units that may not have been constructed in the absence of the PILOT agreement.
